Looking for affordable and modern studio apartments in Whitefield? Key Takeaways

  • Whitefield offers a variety of studio apartments for rent that has modern amenities.
  • Some popular and trusted properties from KOTS are KOTS Bien, KOTS Hamlet, KOTS Soir, KOTS Neuf, and KOTS Une.

Why Choose Studio Apartments in Whitefield at KOTS?

Choosing a studio apartment for rent in Whitefield at KOTS offers you comfort, convenience, and an easy lifestyle, especially for young working professionals, bachelor's, and students.

  • Excellent amenities including, high-speed WiFi, 24/7 power-backup, gym, rooftop gardens, EV charging, and professional housekeeping.
  • High safety standards: gated Apartment including CCTV, security staff, and secure door access.
  • Close to reputed schools, hospitals, and popular restaurants, offering a balanced urban lifestyle.
  • With flexible lease terms and no hidden fees, this allows for fair and flexible renting.
